internal_link_matrix.description: Every post links to the pillar and at least 2 spokes. The pillar links to all spokes. Cross-cluster links are added where semantically relevant.
link_rules: Every spoke links UP to the pillar (anchor: pillar's primary keyword)
Pillar links DOWN to every spoke (anchor: spoke's primary keyword)
Spokes in the same cluster link to each other (2-3 contextual links)
Cross-cluster links where semantically relevant (0-1 per spoke)
All links use descriptive anchor text, never 'click here' or 'read more'

execution_order.reason: Pillar first — all spokes link to it
Highest-value spoke — zero competition, core product use case
Rewrite of existing post — absorbs into cluster early
Marketing playbook — links to B2 which is now written
Rewrite of existing post — links to B2 and A1 which are now written
Sourcing guide — links to A2 and C1 which are now written
Authority content — last because it's least urgent for conversion

quality_gates.cannibalization: No two posts share a primary keyword. Verified during planning.
quality_gates.link_completeness: Every post has 3+ incoming internal links. Verified in matrix.
quality_gates.template_diversity: 4 distinct templates: pillar-page, how-to-guide, data-driven-list, comparison, industry-analysis.
quality_gates.image_coverage: Every post has 1 hero + 2-3 inline images with generation prompts.
